title: Web Build: 2D Skeleton Bone Texture Warping Over Time
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in v4.4.1.stable.official [49a5bc7b6]

### System information

Godot v4.4.1.stable - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 Ti (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6109) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-12900K (24 threads)

### Issue description

I'm encountering a weird visual texture deformation of a part of my skeleton-rigged 2D player character but only in the web build. When I run the game through the editor's debugger or from a Windows build, I do not encounter this problem.

The more the player character runs on the ground, the more warped his foot gets.

Here is a video in which I describe and show the problem:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/7f40e2a8-a5a1-4c3c-ab41-303790c7436b

### Steps to reproduce

- Clone the MRP repo
- Open the project in Godot v4.4.1
- Go to Project > Export and export with the Web preset
- Start a [web server](https://blog.snowfrog.dev/quick-and-easy-local-web-server/) at the /dist folder
- In a browser, navigate to the server's ip address... the game will load
- Start the game by hitting `space`
- Let the player run on the ground and look at its left foot. The texture will progressively get  more and more deformed.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

https://github.com/snowfrogdev/jetpack-joyride-clone
